neutral_facts.correct_value: The deceased couple had set up a separate residence and lived independently of the in-laws. The wife was found stabbed to death in a Pondicherry hotel room. A charge sheet under ss.302 and 498-A r/w 34 IPC alleged dowry-related cruelty and murder by all three accused. The husband committed suicide shortly after, and charges against him abated. The parents-in-law were implicated on the basis of s.161 statements.
neutral_facts.quote: The High Court discharged the parents-in-law as there was no sufficient evidence to link them to the crime.
neutral_facts.reason: Facts reveal the High Court's discharge outcome, which neutral facts must not disclose.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment states no punishment range for ss.302 or 498-A.

attempt_completion.reason: The murder was completed; the deceased was found murdered.

physical_harm.reason: Body bore several stab wounds; charge refers to multiple injuries causing death.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Two offences: s.302 IPC and s.498-A IPC, each r/w s.34 IPC
number_of_offences.quote: Charges u/ss. 302, 498-A r/w s.34 IPC were framed against the three accused

premeditation_planning.reason: Court made no finding on premeditation; it only found the conspiracy allegation insufficient.

motive.reason: Dowry harassment is identified as the motive.
